name: 79927 · El Paso, TX
findings: ZIP 79927 (El Paso) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79927 (El Paso) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
